title: Chapter 2871 - 149: Witch Vulture God Descent
content:
Chapter 2871: Chapter 149: Witch Vulture God Descent

Like a cat smelling fish, Mo Hua felt all his pores start to tremble slightly. He couldn’t help but murmur softly:

"Divine... Descent..."

Though his voice was light, it was still noticed by Yan Zhu, who outwardly had been "ignoring" Mo Hua but internally was always paying attention to him.

Including Mo Hua’s faint surprise and odd expression, this did not escape Yan Zhu’s keen perception.

Yan Zhu smirked disdainfully, "What’s this? This ’Shaman Sir’ doesn’t know about the Divine Descent?"

Usually, even if Mo Hua didn’t know, he would pretend to, to maintain the face of a "Shaman."

But this time was different.

Mo Hua was like a cat mesmerized by a fish, couldn’t help but nod: "I don’t know, can you tell me about it?"

Yan Zhu was taken aback, not expecting Mo Hua to be so straightforward, and then sneered:

"What? Your ’Divine Lord’ hasn’t even told you about this? And you have the nerve to call yourself a shaman?"

Mo Hua said nothing, silently enduring Yan Zhu’s sarcasm.

To be broad-minded, in the face of great matters, he could endure these little "disrespects" from Yan Zhu.

Yan Zhu saw Mo Hua not responding, so he did not continue with more mockery, lest he appear petty for being in the late stage of Golden Core.

Having regained some face was enough.

Yan Zhu’s expression became solemn, speaking slowly:

"The Wujiu Tribe, a third-grade Great Witch Wind Mountain Realm, is an ancient tribe with a long heritage. Yet, in recent centuries, the tribe’s power has waned, unnoticed."

"Until the previous Great Chief, who inspired by ambitions, forsook luxury, sacrificed enjoyment, worked tirelessly to reform the tribe, breed barbarian soldiers, cultivate witch cultivators, and massively produce barbarian armor... only then did they accumulate sufficient foundation."

"The previous Great Chief exhausted all his spirit and blood qi and died."

"His son succeeded as Great Chief, carrying his legacy, advancing the Wujiu Tribe’s development."

"And the current Chief of Witch Vulture has meticulously planned for hundreds of years, exhausting himself, and now is old and frail."

"His son inherited his will, leading expeditions on behalf of his father, letting the barbarian soldiers of Wujiu Tribe flatten the major mountain realms, unifying the Barbaric Wilderness. Thus, we have the Young Master of Witch Vulture nowadays..."

...

This is a Chapter of three generations who succeeded each other, expanding the tribe’s grand vision.

Even the prominent Great Chiefs and Chief Elders present found themselves feeling sentimental and secretly impressed upon hearing.

It’s just a pity that as the Wujiu Tribe grows stronger, it would be stepping over the corpses of these tribes.

This is a nearly irreconcilable conflict.

Mo Hua frowned slightly, sensing there was a problem within.

The rise of Wujiu Tribe was too "swift," not solved by mere "exhaustion" and "ambitious efforts."

Barbarian soldiers, witch cultivators, a large number of barbarian armor, and numerous demonic riders are tangible cultivation battle power.

This kind of foundation cannot solely be attributed to hard work.

The rise of Wujiu Tribe likely has other hidden aspects.

Mo Hua even suspected that the previous Wujiu Great Chief had obtained some powerful opportunities, which allowed Wujiu Tribe to develop swiftly as if guided by divine assistance.

This thought, not just Mo Hua, but perhaps other Great Chiefs of the various tribes also understood.

Nevertheless, opportunities are only one aspect.

Even with opportunities, without striving, it’s still useless.

The iron-blooded determination and ambition of Wujiu Tribe equally cannot be underestimated.

Yan Zhu continued: "But this ’conquest’ is merely a conquest of territories and military power. What Wujiu Tribe seeks is ’permanent’ rule."

"Therefore, they are likely to invite the deity of Wujiu Tribe to descend upon Vermilion Bird Mountain, using the power of the deity to suppress the faith of various tribes in Vermilion Bird Mountain."

Someone frowned: "Does Wujiu Tribe’s deity have such capabilities?"

Yan Zhu paused for a moment, slowly speaking:

"This matter is a secret within the divine order of the Royal Court and cannot be disclosed externally. However, given the urgency, without clarity, none of you would likely believe..."

Yan Zhu paused and continued explaining: "Ordinary deities naturally lack this capability. Even if they have this capability, there’s no medium to manifest it."

"But the Wujiu Tribe is different. They are an ancient tribe that reveres ancient deities handed down from generations, and uniquely worship a ’one deity’ belief that has never changed from the beginning. Hence, Wujiu’s deity is exceptionally powerful, known in the Divine Way as the ’Wujiu Great Deity.’"

"Moreover, Vermilion Bird Mountain is an ancient mountain. According to the mountain records within the Royal Court, a remote ancient altar lies hidden in the depths of Vermilion Bird Mountain, a sacred place worshiping ancient ’deities’ with supreme authority."

"Once the Wujiu Great Deity descends upon the remote ancient altar, completing the ’Divine Descent’ ritual, the entire divine sense of the Barbarian Tribes in Vermilion Bird Mountain will be influenced. Everyone’s faith might be distorted and reshaped..."

Wujiu Great Deity, remote ancient altar.

Mo Hua’s heart was rocked with surprise.

Other Great Chiefs and Chief Elders were also visibly shocked.

From the clues they had obtained, they anticipated that Wujiu Tribe had ambitions with divine faith, but never expected their plans would be this vast.

Moreover, the ancient altar of Vermilion Bird Mountain is an absolute ancient secret.

Even some of the less experienced Great Chiefs present had never heard of it before.

At least the newly appointed Lugu was completely in the dark.

Flame Wings Great Chief frowned, "How did Wujiu Tribe come to know the secrets of my Vermilion Bird Mountain’s ancient altar?"

Yan Zhu’s eyes slightly narrowed: "Wujiu Tribe also has an ancient line of shamanic heritage. Though less than the Royal Court, focusing their efforts to cultivate one or two powerful shamans is not impossible. These shamans, having delved into the Divine Way and ventured into unknown divine sense insights, naturally might discover some ancient secrets through unpredictable channels."
